profile.summary:
Our services are:

Web & Mobile responsive desing
Content Management Systems | Wordpress | Joomla!
E-commerce | Woocomerce | Prestashop | Shopify
Handcrafted website templates | Wordpress | Adobe Experience Manager
Isotype & Logotype desing | Adobe Illustrator | Adobe Photoshop
Database Management | MySQL | Posgress SQL
SEO positioning
Framework | Laravel | Cake | Symfony | Visual Composer

You can visit us at www.bettocorp.com and watch our portfolio.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and build a systematic trading platform end-to-end in Python and Rust, including data-ingestion pipelines, machine-learning models, and high-performance inference (ONNX / Rust). Own the full architecture independently — from data processing and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring.

positions.title: Fulfillment Associate
positions.description: Resolved complex inventory and logistical discrepancies across multiple stations to keep operations running with minimal downtime. Trained and mentored new associates as a Learning Ambassador in tools, safety, and problem-resolution procedures. Introduced a process improvement (Flow vs. manual Trickle scanning) that reduced processing time and increased throughput.

positions.title: Contract Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained RPG Free programs in the IBS core banking system for Venezuela's largest private bank. Built a real-time reporting system consolidating issued debit/credit card activity across all branches nationwide, giving the bank timely visibility into transaction activity. Led changes to the bank's accounting reconciliation process during the monetary reconversion to 12-digit accounting, keeping critical operations stable through the transition. Developed high-availability CGI programs and data-migration processes on iSeries (DB2, Oracle) supporting 365-day operations; migrated the SMS notification system to a new provider for improved reliability.

company.name: Banesco Banco Universal, via Inversiones Galiang, C.A.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Farmaveterinaria (Spain): Built a complete e-commerce store end-to-end — custom WordPress theme and plugins from scratch, server setup (CentOS / Nginx), and email infrastructure — then migrated it to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, SES) to handle growing sales volume. Marketcursos (Ireland): Migrated an e-learning platform from Drupal to WordPress while preserving the full database (courses, students, orders), and built subscription-gated access to course content. Buenasvidentes (Spain): Designed and optimized 30+ custom WordPress sites from scratch, built a dashboard visualizing daily transaction volume, and implemented an Asterisk / FreePBX system for centralized call routing.

company.name: Latin America Petroleum International Services, S.A.
